name: mcp-courtwatch
description: Free U.S. legal research over CourtListener: case-law and docket search, a free citator check, tables of authorities, RECAP filing histories, oral-argument transcripts, and citation verification that catches fabricated cites.
long_description:
An MCP server over CourtListener, the Free Law Project's open legal database. Built for legal aid, tenant defense, pro-se litigants and public-interest lawyers who cannot afford Westlaw or PACER.

Six of the eleven tools work with no account at all, including `cited_by` — the free citator check for who is still relying on a case — and `oral_argument_transcript`. A free CourtListener API token unlocks the other five and raises the rate limit on all of them; it is optional, so the server is useful the moment it is installed.

Every result is framed as raw public court records rather than as advice, in the payload itself, and `citation_lookup` exists so that a fabricated citation comes back unfound rather than plausible.

courtlistener_api_token.title: CourtListener API token
courtlistener_api_token.description: Optional. Free at courtlistener.com (create an account, then Profile > API). Without it, opinion_search, docket_lookup, court_list, judge_lookup, cited_by, oral_arguments and oral_argument_transcript all still work at the unauthenticated rate limit; case_detail, citation_lookup, case_authorities and docket_entries need it. A token also raises the rate limit on the keyless tools. Sent only to courtlistener.com, as an Authorization header, and never logged.

tools.name: opinion_search
tools.description: Full-text search of U.S. case law and court opinions. Keyless.

tools.name: docket_lookup
tools.description: Search court dockets by case name, free text, or docket number. Keyless.

tools.name: court_list
tools.description: List CourtListener courts and the ids used as the court filter. Keyless.

tools.name: case_detail
tools.description: Fetch a full case by id: a cluster's metadata, or one opinion's full text. Needs a token.

tools.name: citation_lookup
tools.description: Verify citations in a draft against the database of real cases; catches fabricated cites. Needs a token.

tools.name: judge_lookup
tools.description: Look up judges and people in CourtListener's judiciary database. Keyless.

tools.name: cited_by
tools.description: Every opinion citing a given opinion — a free citator check. No treatment classification. Keyless.

tools.name: case_authorities
tools.description: The authorities an opinion relies on, with a per-authority citation depth. Needs a token.

tools.name: docket_entries
tools.description: A federal docket's filing history from the RECAP archive. Needs a token.

tools.name: oral_argument_transcript
tools.description: An oral argument's machine-generated Whisper transcript, paged, with CourtListener's own transcription-status verdict. Keyless.
